svg.title: Global user instructions and project context files
svg.desc: A global CLAUDE.md contains example paths to WRITING.md, CODING.md, MODELING.md, and CONVENTIONS.md, with instructions on when to read them. Each paper keeps its own instructions, status, tasks, current specification, and decision log in project context files. The website keeps CLAUDE.md, STATUS.md, TASKS.md, and DESIGN.md for its agreed design requirements.
